answer: To secure a distributed sensor network deployed from the coastal wharf to the high desert mesa, each autonomous agent must lock a staking collateral of fifty Ether subject to slashing penalties. When submitting observations of a volcanic plume, agents must couple their data with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function proof that ensures sequential computation time. This cryptographic boundary enforces a negative expected attack utility and yields a robust Nash equilibrium where identity cloning is mathematically and economically infeasible.
